flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/{DataHiveUenFinJobService, DataHiveUenFinService (collectFinCallResult, collectUenCallResult)}, workflows/datahivefinreport/*, workflows/datahiveuenreport/*, workflows/agencies/mha/report/{jobs/MhaReportJob, helpers/MhaReportHelper}, utilities/emailutility/EmailService, cron-schedules-*.properties, application-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: workflows/reports/daily/DailyReportServiceImpl, auth/interceptor/OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui: pages/Report/{lists/ReportList, lists/ReportListDHFin, lists/ReportListDHUen, hook/useDownloadReport}, pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Story status: 'Fully paid'. Three Excel reports are produced after the MHA/DataHive job: MHA (NRIC), DataHive UEN and DataHive FIN, each with Summary, Success and Error sheets, saved to Azure Blob and searchable/downloadable from the Reports tab in the staff portal. Gaps: (1) the DH UEN/FIN job is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, so the DH reports are not produced if that value is used in PROD (cannot verify from repo); (2) the MHA report has an open defect OCMS-DF-2026-178 (Ready to UAT): zero counts and sent twice in PROD because files are encrypted; (3) in UAT/PROD email.enableSmtp=false and the DH reports do not set an email source, so their email is not sent (EmailService.java:65-75), while the MHA report is given source MHA_REPORT; (4) there is no OCMS_REPORT_DH_FIN/OCMS_REPORT_DH_UEN mapping in api-authorization.properties, so a user holding only that function gets 403 on the list and download (a user with another report function such as MHA/LTA passes because the paths are the same); (5) the 'OIC dashboard' in code is the Reports page, not Dashboard.tsx. Cadence: the job runs Monday-Saturday three times a day and is skipped on public holidays (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:61-71), not one report per day. There is no ICA-specific report; ICA/DOS is assumed to go through MHA and DataHive (cannot verify from repo). Maintenance tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-178 (MHA report), OCMS-DF-2026-149 (Report export moved to backend, does not change the verdict).
recommendation: Claim the DataHive UEN and FIN reports (Summary, Success, Error content) and the download mechanism from Reports. Mark Sebagian for the MHA report (defect OCMS-DF-2026-178), the DH job status in PROD and download access for the DH functions. Suggested fixes: DH function mapping in api-authorization, an email source for the DH reports and confirmation of the job flag in PROD

steps.step: The daily job sends IDs to MHA (NRIC) and DataHive (UEN and FIN), receives particulars, then triggers report generation
steps.detail: The MHA download scheduler runs Monday-Saturday at 11:30, 16:30, 23:30 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119) and skips public holidays (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:61-71); after the MHA NRIC job, the second job DH UEN and FIN runs only when the uenfin flag is on (:101-107) and DataHiveUenFinJobService triggers the FIN and UEN reports after the job finishes, success or failure (DataHiveUenFinJobService.java:57-70). That flag is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:52 (comment: stays off in PROD until the DataHive view names are verified), true in UAT (cron-schedules-uat.properties:52); the deployed value cannot verify from repo. So in PROD only the NRIC (MHA) path is guaranteed to run. That ICA/DOS means MHA/DataHive also cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The MHA (NRIC) summary report shows the number of records sent and received with Success and Error lists
steps.detail: MhaReportJob (generate_mha_daily_summary_rpt) builds an Excel with Summary, Success and Error sheets; the Summary has 'Total no. of records submitted to MHA' and 'returned by MHA' (MhaReportHelper.java:341-354), the file is uploaded to blob (:244-251) and emailed with source MHA_REPORT (MhaReportJob.java:207-222). Open defect OCMS-DF-2026-178 (Ready to UAT, reported 28 Aug 2026): in PROD the MHA files are encrypted so the report is built before processing finishes, counts are 0, and it is sent twice. Hence Sebagian.

steps.step: The DataHive UEN report summarises the number of UENs sent and not found, per processing stage
steps.detail: DatahiveUenReportHelper builds an Excel with Summary, Success and Error sheets (DatahiveUenReportHelper.java:174-176); the Summary has 'Total no. of UEN IDs sent to DataHive for enquiry' and 'not found in any DataHive dataset' (:236-237) with a breakdown per stage RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (:25, 247-249). The job saves the file to blob (DatahiveUenReportJob.java:114) and sends an email (:156). Runs only when the DH job is on (see step 1).

steps.step: The DataHive FIN report summarises the number of FINs sent and not found, per processing stage
steps.detail: DatahiveFinReportHelper builds an Excel Summary/Success/Error (DatahiveFinReportHelper.java:254-257); the Summary has 'Total no. of FIN IDs sent to DataHive for enquiry' and 'not found in any DataHive dataset' (:317-318) per stage RD1-DR3 (:26, 329-331). The job saves to blob (DatahiveFinReportJob.java:114) and sends an email (:156). Same as UEN: runs only when the DH job is on.

steps.step: The report includes exceptions: records that failed or were not found, with the suspension applied
steps.detail: Each record is logged as success or failed/not found through collectFinCallResult and collectUenCallResult (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1053, 1067, 1129, 1136, 1149). The Error sheet holds notice, stage, next processing date, offence date/time, suspension type and reason (DatahiveFinReportHelper.java:223-235); the FIN report also adds rows for pass records not refreshed in that run (:141-191). A successful record that got a suspension is counted as an error (success && lastSuspensionType == null, :1129).

steps.step: The reports are routed to the OIC's dashboard so the OIC can download them
steps.detail: The DH FIN/UEN reports are saved to blob (DatahiveFinReportHelper.java:273-282) and a 'DataHive FIN/UEN Reports' tab exists on the Reports page, protected by hasFunction REPORT_DH_FIN/REPORT_DH_UEN (ReportList.tsx:129-141); files are listed through POST daily-report/search with prefix DHFIN_REPORT_/DHUEN_REPORT_ (DailyReportServiceImpl.java:40-41, 177-178) and downloaded through download/blob (useDownloadReport.ts:27-33). Gaps: (a) it is the Reports page, not Dashboard.tsx; (b) api-authorization.properties has no OCMS_REPORT_DH_FIN/OCMS_REPORT_DH_UEN mapping (only MHA, LTA, VHUB, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT at :129-142), so the interceptor returns 403 for a user holding only the DH functions (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:58-72), unless the user also has another report function; the per-role function assignment cannot verify from repo; (c) the DH report email sets no source, and in UAT/PROD enableSmtp=false (application-prod.properties:80; EmailService.java:65-75), so the email is not sent and the job records a failure after the blob is saved (DatahiveFinReportJob.java:156-161).
